ollama._comment: Ollama code reviewers run only when OLLAMA_HOST is set and models is non-empty (e.g. ["qwen3-coder-next:latest"]); the OLLAMA_MODELS env var overrides models. The server needs OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH >= 65536, otherwise prompts are silently truncated and the review fails. temperature null leaves the server default (Ollama /v1 uses 1.0); set a number to override. Models run sequentially: worst-case wait per section is models x timeout_seconds. Plugin updates overwrite edits to this file, so OLLAMA_MODELS is the durable way to choose models.
